page.desc: Lean projects, each with an unofficial, AI-assisted plain-English explainer.
page.taglineHtml: Lean 4 projects, each read back into plain English: statements, proof outlines, quizzes.
page.notesHtml: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the projects' authors. Every project belongs to its authors, linked on its card. The explainers are AI-assisted, pinned to one commit each, and may contain errors. Projects without a licence file are explained in prose only.
page.suggestHtml: Corrections or take-down requests: open an issue.
